items.label: SMALL TOOL KIT
items.value: This 144 piece home Tool Set is an essential tool set for daily home project and maintenance like furniture assembly, picture hanging and general purpose repairs, apartment, dorm room, or garage and automotive needs

items.label: TOOLS BOX LIST
items.value: (1) 8 oz Claw Hammer, (30) screwdriver bits, (1) bit driver, (1) bit holder/extension (16) hex keys, (4) precision screwdrivers, (1) slip joint plier, (1) tape measure, (1) utility knife, (1)8" Scissors (1)Hammer Cover (1)Storage box

items.label: DURABLE& RELIABLE
items.value: All the tools are constructed from premium material and precisely manufactured to ensure durability and longevity

items.label: EASY ORGANIZATION
items.value: The Tools come neatly organized in a small hard plastic case to keep all your tools organized and securely stored, small enough to be hidden in closets, your garage or even under the kitchen sink

items.label: THE PERFECT GIFT
items.value: This tool set contains useful tools for any basic household repair, and doubles as the perfect thoughtful gift for any new grad headed to college, or a friend or family member moving into a new apartment or starter home
